Run the full Promotion QA on the corrected current-fixes source.

The previous run exposed that wall-clock settlement time was the wrong owner for an automatic deadline: a convergence attempt can become eligible before an automatic/urgent deadline but settle after it. This revision binds that decision to the convergence job's scheduler eligibility time and carries it through asynchronous Drive catch-up.

Certify:
- a pre-deadline sync/convergence opportunity cannot consume a still-unspent automatic/urgent opportunity, even when async settlement happens after that deadline;
- the later automatic opportunity is preserved exactly once;
- once an attempt becomes eligible at/after that deadline, same-revision failure backoff may govern without a hot loop;
- newer canonical revisions retain their own automatic/urgent deadline;
- all prior source-freshness, startup gating, durable pending-intent, suspension/preemption, managed recovery, provider independence, Active Session ownership, PWA/service-worker, Insights, architecture, mutation, browser and release contracts.

No workflow change is part of this request.
